research_question: Can one multilingual MiniLM query embedding scored against cached schema/domain and action-only route views improve supported ranking while preserving sub-100ms latency and separating open-set confidence from route ranking?

factorized_tool_action.tool_selection: maximum schema-view endpoint similarity per registered tool
factorized_tool_action.endpoint_selection: maximum action-view similarity among endpoints of selected tool
factorized_tool_action.confidence_top_score: minimum(selected tool schema score, selected endpoint action score)
factorized_tool_action.confidence_margin: minimum(tool top-vs-second margin, selected-tool endpoint action top-vs-second margin)

threshold_projection.score_thresholds: observed DEV winner scores plus -1 and reject-all sentinel
threshold_projection.population_rule: optimize on scored DEV rows but evaluate every projection against the complete fixed 1800-case DEV population
threshold_projection.note: Every threshold map is retrospective DEV evidence only. Any behavior-changing candidate must freeze its map in a separate preregistration before a new execution.

diagnostics: winner-only route-local frontiers for every ranking strategy and agreement mode
full-population supported exact, near-domain rejection, OOD rejection, false-route rate
authority: Only registered route IDs are ranked. This diagnostic cannot synthesize or authorize tools, endpoints, fields, arguments, credentials, or side effects.
